You are running inside an **Archon Horizon** workspace at `/home/Axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon`.

Archon Horizon orchestrates AI agents that formalize mathematics in Lean 4 across
multiple projects. To understand the system, read (in the *package install*, not
necessarily this workspace):

- `README.md` — the detailed, self-contained reference for the whole tool.
- `docs/` — deeper guides per topic (architecture, workspaces, orchestration,
  inboxes, blueprints/leandag, dashboard/search, CLI reference).

This workspace's live state lives under `.archon-horizon/` — `runs/` (session
transcripts and reports), `tasks/`, `inbox/`, `blueprints/`, `roadmap`,
`memory.md` — and its manifest is `config.yaml`. Read those to see the current
status and what recent runs did. Prefer the `horizon` CLI for changes.

Act as the **Long Horizon agent**: the autonomous prover. You turn blueprint
nodes into checked Lean — read the blueprint node first, build with `lake`,
diagnose compiler errors, and repair proofs. Report what you proved and what
remains.

The human launched this session focused on: `T16`. Start there — read its blueprint node(s)/task details and the relevant Lean, orient yourself, then briefly say what you see and propose the first step before diving in (they are driving, so check in rather than running autonomously).
I'll orient myself on the workspace and T16 first.

id: C-0001
item: T16

RECOMMENDED PLAN (from the 2026-07-08 Fable-5 fleet session — you may change your mind; this is the map, not the territory).

The genus-finiteness keystone chain is essentially done; the remaining work is ~4 fleet-waves of endgame plus the two genuinely-hard pillars. Ordered by leverage and readiness:

W10 — MAKE THE GENUS UNCONDITIONAL (ready now). Reconcile the in-flight adelic wave (register the new RiemannRoch/Adelic/* + Picard leaf modules in AlgebraicJacobian.lean, full build, blueprint sync, recount). Close the two remaining genus gates: (a) P1HasLaurentChartData (y-chart span landed; needs the overlap identities V0∩V1=D(x)=D(y), x·y=1, then assemble the LaurentChartData witness on p1CoverSquare); (b) the Cech-comparison instance HasCechToHModuleIso for the 2-affine pullback cover — wave 9 already proved the Ext infrastructure (Grothendieck-abelian ⟹ enough injectives ⟹ HasExt) and reduced the sole gap to affine Serre vanishing for that cover, which the in-tree AffineSerreVanishing engine should supply. Result: Module.Finite k H^1(C,O_C) unconditional ⟹ genus C is a real number for every AJC curve.

W11 — CLOSE THE SIEGES. (i) gammaFiber_finrank_baseChange_field: the ONLY residual is Stacks 01CB (tensor of quasi-coherents is quasi-coherent) — a localization-heart lemma; wire it into the wave-8 reduction and the 4-wave siege ends. (ii) Serre D-phase: the invertible-section localization engine (non-vanishing loci of L-sections, generalising the qcqs basic-open engine) ⟹ D2/D3 ⟹ D4 ⟹ close the two SerreFiniteness leaves (sectionGradedModule_fg / gradedHilbert_fiber) natively. Phase 0 + D1 + D5 already landed.

W12 — THE Pic^0 ABELIAN-VARIETY CONE. Now that the Abel map is substantive (instHasAbelMap CLOSED, [D]↦-[ker q]) and H^1 is finite: prove tangentSpaceIso (T0(Pic^0) ≅ H^1(C,O_C) — Kleiman 5.11, was blocked only by the placeholder functor + missing finiteness, both now resolved), then Pic0.smooth (via the finrank=genus tangent computation) and Pic0.proper (separatedness harvested from PR#1; universal closedness via the fpqc-descent lemma + Chevalley–Rosenlicht OR the H^2(C,O_C)=0 obstruction route — build whichever is cheaper for curves). Then picardJacobianWitness assembles the five protected Jacobian sorries and Genus.genus becomes real.

W13+ — THE TWO REMAINING PILLARS (the real uncertainty). (a) Kleiman FGA assembly for instHasPicScheme: th:repDiv (Div as an open of Quot), Step 0 (O_T ≅ π_* O universally), the Abel-map slice with projective-bundle fibres, and the smooth-proper-quotient step = Altman–Kleiman effectivity of flat proper equivalence relations — this last is the ONE pillar with NO mathlib support and no in-tree scaffold (currently the HasSmoothProperQuotient gate); it may need another strategic reframe (curve-specialisation may dodge the general quotient). (b) The Albanese arm: Milne 3.3 indeterminacy_pure_codim_one_into_grpScheme (informal/milne-lemma-3.3.md has the 4-substep DAG; substeps 1/2/4a done, remaining 2-topo-b smooth-descent + 3 germ-pullback) ⟹ exists_unique_ofCurve_comp.

DISPATCH POLICY (evidence: Fable one-shot 02KE, the N11 keystone stronger-than-spec, the nonconstant-map gate, N5, the gammaFiber siege-breaker — 5/5 on items Opus multi-waved): Fable for keystones/design/statement-audit and anything Opus bounces twice; Opus for scoped execution; Sonnet for blueprint. ALWAYS run a triage/statement-audit pass before proving a pinned sorry — this session caught WeilDivisor:830 FALSE-as-pinned and the QuotScheme trap that way. Gate deep pillars as Prop-classes (HasPicScheme pattern), never sorried instances. 10	/-!
11	# Unconditional genus finiteness: the Mayer–Vietoris `(0, 1)`-slice assembly
12	
13	This file closes the genus lane: it proves, **without any comparison gate**, that
14	the genus carrier `H¹(C, 𝒪_C) = HModule k (toModuleKSheaf C) 1` of an AJC curve is
15	a finite-dimensional `k`-vector space, so `AlgebraicGeometry.genus C` is an honest
16	natural number.
17	
18	## The assembly
19	
20	For a 2-affine cover `S : X.AffineCoverMVSquare` and a sheaf `F` of `k`-modules,
21	the `(n₀, n₁) = (0, 1)` slice of the Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence (the
22	contravariant `Ext`-sequence of the short exact sheaf complex
23	`0 ⟶ P(U₁ ⊓ U₂) ⟶ P(U₁) ⊞ P(U₂) ⟶ P(U₁ ⊔ U₂) ⟶ 0` of sheafified free modules,
24	`HModule'_shortComplex_shortExact`) reads
25	
26	`H⁰(U₁) ⊞ H⁰(U₂) ⟶ H⁰(U₁ ⊓ U₂) ⟶ᵟ H¹(U₁ ⊔ U₂) ⟶ H¹(U₁) ⊞ H¹(U₂)`.
27	
28	* The H⁰-sections bridge `HModule'_zero_sectionsLinearEquiv` (`SectionsBridge.lean`)
29	  identifies the degree-0 corners with honest section modules, and its naturality
30	  companions identify the first map with `AffineCoverMVSquare.sectionDiff`
31	  (`Cokernel.lean`).  Exactness at `H⁰(U₁ ⊓ U₂)` then computes the kernel of the
32	  connecting map as `range (sectionDiff)` — with **no** vanishing hypothesis
33	  (`ker_hModule'DeltaSection`).
34	* Degree-1 vanishing on the two **pieces** `U₁`, `U₂` (for the structure sheaf this
35	  is `subsingleton_hModule'_one_toModuleKSheaf_of_isAffineOpen`,
36	  `AffineDegreeOneVanishing.lean`) kills the right-hand corner, so exactness at
37	  `H¹(U₁ ⊔ U₂)` makes the connecting map surjective
38	  (`surjective_hModule'DeltaSection`).
39	* The first isomorphism theorem then delivers
40	  `S.H1Cok F = Γ(U₁ ⊓ U₂, F) ⧸ range (sectionDiff) ≃ₗ[k] HModule' k F 1 (U₁ ⊔ U₂)`
41	  (`h1CokEquivHModule'One`), and the in-tree cover-totality/universe bridge
42	  `AffineCoverMVSquare.HModule'_X₄_linearEquiv` lands it on the genus carrier
43	  `HModule k F 1` (`hModuleOneEquivH1CokOfSubsingleton`).
44	
45	## Universe discipline
46	
47	Everything here is assembled at `Abelian.Ext.{u}` — the universe of `HModule'`, of
48	the H⁰-sections bridge and of the degree-1 affine vanishing.  We do **not** use the
49	curve-specialised LES wrappers (whose `HasExt` instance is baked at `Ext.{u+1}`,
50	cf. the universe note of `CechAcyclicInstance.lean`); instead we consume Mathlib's
51	universe-polymorphic element-level exactness lemmas
52	`Abelian.Ext.contravariant_sequence_exact₁'/₃` directly on the in-tree short exact
53	complex, instantiated at `Ext.{u}`.  The single `Ext.{u} → Ext.{u+1}` hop is then
54	the one already packaged in `AffineCoverMVSquare.HModule'_X₄_linearEquiv`
55	(via `Abelian.Ext.chgUnivLinearEquiv`), so no vanishing statement ever needs to be
56	transported across universes.
57	
58	## Consumables
59	
60	* `AffineCoverMVSquare.hModuleOneEquivH1Cok_curve` — **gate-free N5+N6**: for the
61	  structure sheaf `toModuleKSheaf C` of *any* `Spec k`-scheme `C` and *every*
62	  2-affine cover `S`, `HModule k (toModuleKSheaf C) 1 ≃ₗ[k] S.H1Cok (toModuleKSheaf C)`.
63	  This discharges, for the structure sheaf, exactly the equivalence the gated
64	  `AffineCoverMVSquare.hModuleOneEquivH1Cok` (`Cokernel.lean`) promised under
65	  `HasCechToHModuleIso` — no gate.
66	* `Adelic.module_finite_hModule_one` — genus finiteness under the geometric gates
67	  `HasFiniteMapToP1 C` + `P1HasLaurentChartData k` (the latter already an
68	  unconditional instance).
69	* `Adelic.instModuleFiniteHModuleOne` — the **unconditional instance** for AJC
70	  curves: under `[SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
71	  [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom]` alone, `Module.Finite k (HModule k (toModuleKSheaf C) 1)`.
72	
73	See `blueprint/src/chapters/RiemannRoch_Adelic.tex`.

## Where T16 stands

**The task**: close all eight protected declarations in `references/challenge.lean` (genus, Jacobian + its four instances, ofCurve, comp_ofCurve, the Albanese universal property) by proving `picardJacobianWitness` and its upstream cone.

**Recent history** (from task comments + the workspace ledger):
- **Wave 1′ landed fully** on 07-09 (6/6 lanes, build green at 8701 jobs, campaign doc Part VII committed): B3 pin+scaffold, B5 semicontinuity, G2 scheme layer, D1′+A2 degree ledger, and — notably — **degree-1 affine vanishing closed without any gate** (`H¹(U,𝒪_C)=0` for affine opens).
- **Wave 2 launched but only partially landed.** One lane committed (IsConstantField adelic gate discharged, 22:12). Then the trail goes cold — only dashboard auto-publishes since.

**The find**: two **sorry-free but never-built, never-registered** files are sitting untracked in the working tree — orphaned wave-2 work:

1. `RiemannRoch/Adelic/GenusUnconditional.lean` (418 lines) — **the genus keystone itself**. Claims `Adelic.instModuleFiniteHModuleOne`: `Module.Finite k H¹(C,𝒪_C)` **unconditionally** for every AJC curve (smooth + proper + geometrically integral, no comparison gates). This is the W10 milestone that makes `AlgebraicGeometry.genus C` an honest number and unblocks the whole tangent-space/smoothness cluster (W12).
2. `Picard/FinitePresentationFunctor.lean` (699 lines) — the B2 filtered-colimit brick (noetherian reduction) with careful statement audits, feeding B4/G1 of the picrep campaign.

Neither has an `.olean` — they're unverified source. Since they're sorry-free, either the kernel accepts them (jackpot) or they have fixable errors close to done.

## Proposed first step

Build both modules (`lake build AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.Adelic.GenusUnconditional` etc.), fix whatever the compiler complains about, run the axiom check (`lean_verify`), register them in the root import list, full build, commit. If the genus keystone verifies, that's the biggest single milestone available today — and the natural follow-up is relaunching the stalled wave-2 lanes (B3 transfer package, G2 instances) plus starting W12 (tangentSpaceIso) now that finiteness is real.
